rows.corpus_definition: A solid object made to look like a person or thing.
rows.example_en: There is a beautiful marble sculpture in the park.
He seldom visits us because he lives very far.

rows.corpus_definition: to pick one thing from a group of choices
rows.example_en: Please select the color you like best.

rows.corpus_definition: A person elected to help make the country's laws.
rows.example_en: The senator gave a speech yesterday.

rows.corpus_definition: Tell a player to leave the field because they broke rules.
rows.example_en: The referee had to send off the aggressive player.

rows.corpus_definition: A physical feeling or a general awareness.
rows.example_en: I had a strange sensation in my arm.

rows.corpus_definition: The ability to find things funny.
rows.example_en: He has a great sense of humour.
We set off early to avoid traffic.

rows.corpus_definition: A painful feeling of being embarrassed or bad.
rows.example_en: He felt great shame for his actions.

rows.corpus_definition: To break suddenly into many very small pieces.
rows.example_en: The glass will shatter if it hits the floor.
